prose: Short note from feed metadata only: The Information (Jyoti Mann) reports that Meta built a prototype humanoid robot with Chinese robotics firm Fourier in about three months and is already building a second, while saying it has no plans to sell the units. The speed of the prototype - three months with an experienced partner - is the detail that matters: Meta can iterate in hardware faster than its AI-first image suggests. The source is paywalled, so this rests on the feed summary alone.
highlights: Meta built a humanoid prototype with China's Fourier in ~3 months; a second is underway, per The Information
Meta says it has no plans to sell the units
Prototype speed via an established robotics partner is the real signal
Summary based on feed metadata only; The Information is paywalled
